name: flaggems__upsample_bilinear2d_aa_backward
description: Backward pass of 2D bilinear upsampling with anti-aliasing (area-weighted filter). Scatters grad_output (N,C,H_out,W_out) into grad_input (N,C,H_in,W_in) using the same area/support weights as the forward _upsample_bilinear2d_aa op.
reference:
import torch

def run(grad_output, output_size, input_size, align_corners, scales_h, scales_w):
    return torch.ops.aten._upsample_bilinear2d_aa_backward(
        grad_output, output_size, input_size, align_corners, scales_h, scales_w)

def run_correctness(grad_output, output_size, input_size, align_corners, scales_h, scales_w):
    inp = torch.zeros(
        tuple(int(s) for s in input_size),
        dtype=grad_output.dtype,
        device=grad_output.device,
        requires_grad=True,
    )
    out = torch._C._nn._upsample_bilinear2d_aa(
        inp,
        [int(output_size[0]), int(output_size[1])],
        align_corners,
        scales_h,
        scales_w,
    )
    out.backward(grad_output)
    return inp.grad
